digest.component_or_area: rebar store sync / reconverge union merge
key_entities: Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge
propositions: Reconverge union merge aborts when local working-tree deletions or modifications to tracked store artifacts conflict with origin/tickets changes, leaving local commits orphaned and unable to advance.
Extend the existing merge-abort recovery seam to detect and parse the 'Your local changes...would be overwritten by merge' signature and extract the named file paths.

For tracked files with working-tree deletions (git status ' D' or staged 'D '), restore non-destructively from HEAD via git checkout; for working-tree modifications (' M'), copy bytes to reconverge-quarantine directory before restoring, then retry the merge once.
Genuine merge conflicts (both sides commit different content) retain existing abort behavior: abort, keep local, hint fsck-recover.
Interrupted fold operations that leave tracked file deletions (compact_txn renames via *.retired) are self-healed by this recovery mechanism regardless of upstream marker removal.
